content.short: PACT is a decentralized RWA and lending protocol on Aptos and Celo providing access to on-chain credit.
content.description:
PACT is a leading decentralized finance protocol specializing in tokenized real-world assets (RWAs) and automated credit markets. Built natively on the Aptos and Celo blockchains, the platform manages hundreds of millions in TVL, making it a primary destination for institutional-grade yields. PACT enables users to access decentralized lending and payment services that are backed by diversified real-world portfolios, bridging the gap between traditional credit markets and the Web3 ecosystem.

Deeply integrated with high-performance DEXs like Hyperion, PACT offers users yield-bearing pools that inherit the security and transparency of on-chain settlement. The protocol is also associated with social impact initiatives like impactMarket on Celo, leveraging blockchain technology for poverty alleviation. By providing a secure and scalable framework for digital asset management, PACT is empowering participants to build more robust and inclusive decentralized financial strategies globally.
